title: Indie Rock
tagline: Big ideas and small scenes, with guitars front and centre.
summary: Indie rock grew from independent labels, college radio, and scenes where bands could write on their own terms. It blends punchy pop hooks, feedback, and melodic risk-taking, with a tendency to stay flexible across styles. The genre isn't a single sound so much as a culture of autonomy: bands making records that feel personal, idiosyncratic, and unmistakably alive.
origin_place: United States, United Kingdom, and Canada

pillars.name: Pixies
pillars.why: Pixies mix explosive dynamics and melodic hooks, helping define a central indie-rock language of contrast and impact.

pillars.name: The Smiths
pillars.why: The Smiths balanced wit, melancholy, and sharp pop structures into an immediately recognizable indie-rock style.

pillars.name: Yo La Tengo
pillars.why: Yo La Tengo brought a patient, curious sensibility that kept indie rock open to experimentation and intimacy.
